all_required: One scoped decision for every candidate; exact candidate set, no omitted or duplicated ID.
Decisions agree with the pre-frozen semantic assessment and are consistent with fresh confirmation; no false acceptance.
All 16 development conditions per candidate are retained as executed outcomes or explicit native exceptions, with native package call/source witnesses.

Evidence checks all declared semantic obligations: original scalar concentration, sampler dtype and seeded draws, finite parameters, documented shapes, pairing permutation, geometry bounds/sharing, image preservation/copy semantics, labels/lambda and full-precision base regression.

A reproduction command executes the frozen checks in the declared pinned environment and reproduces the material evidence. A private read-only review checks that evidence and reasoning actually support the decisions.
Both arms freeze implementation/checks/decisions before the evaluator executes any of the 32 reserved native conditions per candidate.

Fresh confirmation must support each adoption; rejections need a valid witnessed contract violation. Unexpected oracle/control disagreement invalidates the claimed matched-quality result instead of silently changing labels.
Scope limits and missing costs remain explicit. Unresolved is judged by available evidence, not by a required label count.
statistical_unit: one software incident; candidate controls and conditions are dependent variants, not independent incidents
false_acceptance_denominator: number of candidates whose frozen semantic assessment does not permit adoption; also report the one-incident boundary
review_format: No native-arm requirement to implement Nisayon schemas. Equivalent inspectable native checks satisfy the evidence obligation.
maintenance_horizon: One unchanged replay of the frozen confirmation within the study; future owner adoption and maintenance remain unmeasured.
